lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the only fold on the part: the L-shaped base plate (outer skin patch 2) bends about 89 deg up into the narrow flange (outer skin patch 4). Perpendicular sections at 2/25/50/75/98% put the label point on the outer-skin arc apex. The offset along the bisector is -0.17/0.03/0.02/-0.02/-0.23 mm and the nearest surface point is 0.08-0.23 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold axis. The bend-zone surface runs about -1 to 17 mm along the line axis; the line covers 0 to 16.57 mm, about 95%, and the face-on close-up shows it spanning the full flange width.
